informal_statement: The arc function equals ell evaluated at the inverse-area angle.
reason: Equivalent in the declared constructor/section context. At MorgansArcFunction.lean:269-271, the source contract is `lemma arc_eq (x : ℝ) : arc x = ell (θOf x)`. The unit-chord normalized area and arc length are constructed on 0 < theta < pi. The inverse is used geometrically only at positive area; its explicit totalization is not confused with an inverse outside that domain.
